findings.title: E-phase R2 surface is fail-open for a non-executable comparator (invalid conflated with null)
findings.description: In runners/battery.py battery_verdict, a killer control with 0 Q-11-aligned pairs yields mean None -> kill False (not an invalid/NOT_RUN row), and runners/rules.py evaluate_r1_r6 sets R2 pass = not family_kill, so a comparator that cannot run is silently treated as 'did not kill' = PASS. No test in tests/test_rates_ng1_i.py covers the 0-pair row (only missing-role raise, tie-not-kill, and battery=None -> R2 NOT_RUN pass False are pinned). This conflicts with the adopted cycle law 'Missing evidence is NOT_RUN, never inferred PASS' (plans/PLAN_crypto_ng1.md sec9, adopted by PLAN_rates_ng1.md sec7-9) and with the Q-11 invalid-vs-null distinction. CONCRETE IMPACT FOR THIS CYCLE IS BOUNDED: the only affected arm is RATESNG1-A5-P1-ARM-CONSERVATIVE (PLACEBO n_pairs_used 0 on the real grid, battery_executed false, honestly disclosed in z_report verdict_basis and pinned by tests/test_rates_ng1_z.py::test_battery_executability_recorded_honestly), and that arm structurally CANNOT become a survivor regardless: it fired all 3 events in fold 2 only (z_report folds_state_events {2:3}), so evaluate_r1_r6 sees folds_present=[2] and R3 (2-of-3 folds positive) fails deterministically. NEUTRAL and AGGRESSIVE batteries are fully executable (placebo n_pairs 96 and 1850). The defect must be resolved (or E explicitly bound to map executable=false/battery_executed=false into an R2 NOT_RUN for that arm, recorded before GO) so no future variant can inherit the fail-open; the auditor is barred from repairing frozen machinery.
